chapter: The Camellia band and home life
title: Surprise party and fish fries on Saturday nights
summary: Mrs. Henderson recalls a surprise party, and the couple recall fish fries and parties, with lanterns hung outside.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: Boy, boy, one night we went and surprised. He was in a wheelchair and him and Lillian was in bed. So I'd seen him running around there in these longs. He couldn't find these pants. He was just like Santa Claus. I'm telling you, there was a tire around there. We were on the bed, you know. And we had all the stuff in baskets and the van waiting until he got in the front of those. He had a wheelchair. It was his. He didn't have no pajamas. He had them long tights. It was kind of cool, you know. He couldn't find these pants. He was just like Santa Claus. Oh, why don't you tell me how to do that? Just run around. They want you to find some clothes. Just run around like a razor. Yes, the time.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: He really was surprised. Who ever do that to me? We had all the stuff in the front of the door and they struck up playing music in the front of the door and bam on the door. We had all the stuff in baskets and tubs. We had a good time that night and we were trying to be a grand big party. It wasn't like now you have a party, you don't have no permit to put you in jail. You can have things like that.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: I think it was the eight years anniversary or the seven. It wasn't long there. It was the anniversary of the surprise. Saturday nights was big nights too.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: You know, a long time when we used to get together and have such a nice time. You didn't have to worry about it. But nah, at least the thing you had, they'll all come get you. If you're playing ready, you're too loud. You look like they come pulling up there until you're disturbing the fish.

Yes, I remember that. And then you could go from one place to the other and it wouldn't be too far. Especially with fish fries in there. Anywhere you would see a little lantern hanging outside, it was a fish fry.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: You could tell it was a fish fry before the lantern was hanging because the lantern started to rain in the front of the door early to eat. And throwing brick. It was written all around the front of the door and then throw brick all around in the alley. And then that night it hanged the lantern out. You know that was a fish fry. You mean the brick dust?

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
